TLS.R5__myeloid_rim_peak: Rim myeloid log density relative to mean core and adjacent exterior; radial peak, not angular enclosure
TLS.R5__myeloid_external_vs_T: External/core myeloid contrast minus external/core T contrast
TLS.R5__myeloid_T_short_vs_long: T–myeloid short-range versus longer-range kNN enrichment
TLS.R5__stroma_rim_peak: Rim stromal peak; angular continuity is not measured
TLS.R5__stroma_penetration_vs_T: Relative stromal penetration into core compared with T cells
TLS.R5__stroma_contact_vs_abundance: T–stroma graph enrichment contrasted with rim stromal/T abundance
TLS.R5__epithelial_interface_vs_stroma: Difference in fractions of T–epithelial and T–stromal edges crossing boundary; epithelial is not a malignancy label
TLS.R5__endothelial_access_B_vs_T: Relative B versus T graph coupling to endothelial predictions; not measured HEV
TLS.R5__plasma_export_vs_B_gradient: Relative plasma outward distribution compared with B cells; not lineage tracing
TLS.R5__B_plasma_crossing_scale: Short versus longer-range B–plasma boundary-crossing fractions
TLS.R5__B_plasma_local_vs_remote: Local versus extended B–plasma graph enrichment
TLS.R5__B_size_vs_T_size: Ratio of probability-weighted median B and T whole-cell areas, log scale
TLS.R5__B_cytoplasm_vs_nucleus_spread: B cytoplasmic versus nuclear 90–10 area spread, log contrast
TLS.R5__B_size_spatial_organization: B nuclear size assortativity × B-core/T-exterior radial organization
TLS.R5__plasma_stroma_export_coupling: Plasma–stromal graph coupling × relative outward plasma distribution
TLS.R5__myeloid_interface_coupling: T–myeloid graph coupling × relative external myeloid distribution
TLS.R5__boundary_entropy_gradient: Exterior minus core mean classifier entropy
TLS.R5__myeloid_soft_hard_radial_sensitivity: Radial difference in normalized soft–hard myeloid count discrepancy
TLS.R5__stroma_soft_hard_radial_sensitivity: Radial difference in normalized soft–hard stromal count discrepancy
TLS.R5__B_T_organization_confidence_weighted: B/T radial organization attenuated by core mean entropy; not calibrated confidence

tail_definition: Within-patient q90 minus median and range; positive-density top20% share requires>=5 TLS. These measure within-patient heterogeneity, not independent patients.
